english: A college has 5 teachers in Physics, 4 in Chemistry and 3 in Mathematics. A committee of 4 teachers is to be formed containing at least one teacher from each of the three departments. Two of the teachers, $X$ (from Physics) and $Y$ (from Mathematics), refuse to serve together on the committee. Then the number of ways of forming the committee is ______.
hindi: एक महाविद्यालय में भौतिकी के 5, रसायन के 4 तथा गणित के 3 शिक्षक हैं। 4 शिक्षकों की एक समिति बनानी है जिसमें तीनों विभागों में से प्रत्येक से कम से कम एक शिक्षक हो। शिक्षकों में से दो, $X$ (भौतिकी से) तथा $Y$ (गणित से), समिति में एक साथ कार्य करने से मना करते हैं। तब समिति बनाने के तरीकों की संख्या ______ है।
solution: Without the refusal: one department gives 2 members: $\binom{5}{2}\cdot4\cdot3+5\binom{4}{2}\cdot3+5\cdot4\binom{3}{2}=120+90+60=270$
Complement: committees with both $X$ and $Y$; the other 2 come from the remaining $4P,4C,2M$ and must include a chemist
solution_full: Committees of 4 with all three departments: the department sizes are $2,1,1$ in some order. Physics twice: $\binom{5}{2}\cdot4\cdot3=120$; Chemistry twice: $5\cdot\binom{4}{2}\cdot3=90$; Mathematics twice: $5\cdot4\cdot\binom{3}{2}=60$. Total $270$.

Remove the committees containing both $X$ and $Y$. With $X$ and $Y$ in, Physics and Mathematics are covered, and the other 2 members come from the remaining $4$ Physics, $4$ Chemistry and $2$ Mathematics teachers, with at least one chemist.
originality_note: New: a committee condition (every department represented) with a refusal clause whose correction term itself needs a complement (the remaining two must supply a chemist) (way 5). Closest known: 'committee of 5 from 6 men and 4 women with at least 2 women' (NCERT) and 'two persons refuse to serve together'. Different because: the refusal correction depends on which departments X and Y already cover. The first design used the NCERT 6-men-4-women base and was replaced.
blueprint_concepts: Committee and team formation with constraints
Counting by bijection and complementary counting

concept_use.Committee and team formation with constr: The committee must include every department (a constraint split into the patterns 2,1,1) and must not contain both X and Y.
concept_use.Counting by bijection and complementary: Complementary counting is used twice: removing committees with both X and Y, and inside that, removing pairs without a chemist (also the check 495 - 231 + 6).

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol and object is defined before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed by an independent brute-force enumeration in Python (sympy/itertools), is unique and matches the Answer Plan. Checked by enumerating all 495 committees (240), that X and Y belong to different departments as stated, and that 240 is a positive 3-digit integer as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Counting the 270 committees with all departments and removing the 30 with both X and Y.
justification: Routine committee casework and a complement; level 2.
